summary: This bill repeals the high-efficiency electric home rebate program, state contractor training grants, and building energy code adoption assistance from Public Law 117-169, rescinds their remaining unobligated funds, and makes a conforming change to an existing rebate provision.

scores.thoughts: This bill directly repeals several Department of Energy programs and rescinds unobligated balances, explicitly reducing government outlays. This is the primary focus of the bill.

The bill repeals programs related to high-efficiency electric home rebates and energy efficiency contractor training, which are designed to promote energy efficiency and reduce carbon emissions. By eliminating these programs, the bill indirectly works against environmental protection efforts, making it a central aspect of the bill's impact.
